title: 3D Systems & Nashville Dental Open House for NextDent Jetted Dentures
summary: 3D Systems and Nashville Dental host a hands-on experience to teach dental labs about the NextDent 300 3D printer and Jetted Denture Solution for durable and aesthetic 3d printed dentures.
body_markdown:
Join 3D Systems & Nashville Dental to learn about the NextDent 300 3D printer and NextDent Jetted Denture Solution for 3D printed dentures. Learn how the NextDent 300 MultiJet 3D Printer can help your lab scale productivity, reduce manual labor, and support consistent high-quality denture production as part of the NextDent Jetted Denture Solution.​


Attend one of our CE accredited sessions to learn about the NextDent Jetted Denture Solution and earn 1 CE credit. Sessions start at 3pm or 5pm.


After the session, get hands-on with the 3D printer and full workflow while getting all of your questions answered by 3D Systems and Nashville Dental experts. Enjoy wine, beer, and charcuterie at our mixer to wrap up the night.


About the NextDent 300 MultiJet 3D Printer:


- Print up to 30 multi-material, monolithic dentures per day (2 print cycles)
- Hands-free support removal
- Custom color-blended tooth shades
- Rigid tooth materials
- 4 diverse base shades
- Impact-resistant base material
